_scope: execution only, at fixed minute boundaries, no strategy signal (the tick window is inside the locked final test)
_coverage: the terminal's tick history has holes (e.g. 2026-11-13 stops near 16:30): only minutes with ticks count; see spread_by_hour_sao_paulo for the hours covered

market_order_vs_model_ticks._meaning: model fill (bar open +/- 1 tick) minus the real touch (ask for a buy, bid for a sell), per side; > 0 = the model is pessimistic by that many ticks

aggressor_trades._meaning: the first buy- (sell-) aggressor trade within 5 s of the minute boundary = what a market order gets

wait_15s_horizon_15min._meaning: mid H minutes after the fill minus the fill price, signed by the side, in ticks; the market order is sent at the same minute boundary
